# Municipal Ordinance No. 05, Series of 2004

**Real Property Tax Discount Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance grants a 50% discount to all delinquent realty taxpayers, a 10% discount to those who pay promptly, and a 20% discount to those who pay in advance, in accordance with Act 341 of the [[RA-7160|Local Government Code of 1991]]. It also repeals any ordinance inconsistent with its provisions and takes effect ten (10) days after its approval.

## Key Provisions

1.  All delinquent taxpayers shall be granted a 50% discount on all realty taxes including surcharges and penalties from January 1, 1998 to December 31, 2003, and a 10% discount should be given to all prompt or paid on time and 20% discount to all advance taxpayers of real property taxes.
2.  All delinquent taxpayers of real property taxes shall be granted a 50% discount provided that the taxes shall be paid up to December 31, 2004.
3.  Every real estate property with unpaid taxes of =P= 10,000.00 or more shall be sold at public auction in accordance with law.
4.  The Municipal Treasurer shall inform all realty taxpayers about the tax discount provided in Sec. 1.
5.  Any ordinance inconsistent with the provision of this ordinance is hereby repealed accordingly.
6.  This ordinance shall take effect Ten (10) days after its approval.
